svg.data-weight-note: 9.5 lb (4.30 kg), spec Table 1-3 row Catalyst 2960S-24TD-L
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC (autoranging), 1 to 0.5 A, 50 to 60 Hz
svg.data-sfp-plus-slots: 2 SFP+ module slots (numbered 25 and 26 here; the guide states no numbers for this model), 10 Gigabit; the SFP+ slots also take 1 Gigabit SFP modules
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: Table 1-3 Supported SFP+ Modules (PDF p12, printed 1-10), the row listing this model: SFP-10G-LR=, SFP-10G-SR=, SFP-10G-LRM=, and SFP-H10GB-CU1M=, -CU3M= and -CU5M= twinax cables.
svg.data-stacking: FlexStack, optional C2960S-STACK module in the rear slot
svg.data-console: USB mini-Type B and RJ-45; the USB port has priority when both are connected (Table 1-10)
